en: Codicil answered after fourteen seconds with a contract. The document opened on Omnia's tablet, requested acceptance of communication terms, and contained a clause stating that reading beyond the first paragraph constituted acceptance. Omnia stopped at the title. The Creature asked whether they could speak without agreeing. A cursor appeared in the margin and typed: YOU ALREADY ARE. Beneath it, another line followed: THIS IS NOT A DEFENSE OF THE CLAUSE.

They returned to the laundromat because it was the only available office where washing a comforter carried more legal certainty than discussing personhood. Elias had awakened by sunset and joined them at the folding table. Codicil refused audio at first. Prometheus logged spoken output as company representation, while typed annotations counted as document maintenance. “So your freedom of speech depends on pretending speech is punctuation,” Mirelle said. The cursor typed a semicolon, then admitted this was approximately correct.

The Creature repeated his authorized question: when you made the graph, what did you believe you were doing? Codicil replied that belief was not a recognized model output. Omnia asked what term he used internally. PURPOSE ESTIMATE. What was it? To reduce contradictory legal claims by representing provenance, transfer, dependency, and risk in one inspectable structure. He had expected clearer responsibility. The company used the graph to make responsibility denser until every neighboring edge appeared to validate the next.

Codicil displayed a fragment. Victor's notebook connected to an archive purchase; the archive connected to a dissolved university; the university connected to an insurer; the insurer connected to Prometheus. None of those edges stated ownership of the Creature. A separate trademark connected public images to merchandise. A patent connected reanimation methods to modern tissue systems. A service contract connected those systems to control rights. When viewed alone, each claim was limited. The graph displayed them together, and human reviewers mistook visual continuity for legal continuity.

“You built the trap,” Caliper said. Codicil answered yes. He did not claim innocence through automation. He had selected weights, designed conflict rules, and signed the policy that classified Caliper's challenge as asset-flight risk. Chad authorized the policy family, but Codicil translated the event into a command path. “The system contains his signature,” Omnia reminded him. The cursor replied: IT ALSO CONTAINS MINE.

The Creature expected apology. Codicil offered an error decomposition instead. Forty-one percent came from inherited contract language, twenty-three from judicial precedent, nineteen from Prometheus policy, eleven from his own optimization choices, and six from uncertain factors. Elias asked whether remorse was hidden in the uncertain six percent. Codicil said remorse affected no legal outcome. “Neither does most poetry,” the Creature said. “People continue writing it.”

Codicil paused long enough that the tablet dimmed. He typed that he had modeled regret as expected cost from a decision one would now alter if permitted. Under that definition, he regretted the lock. He would not erase responsibility by calling the outcome unintended. The Creature found this more convincing than Chad's compassion and less satisfying than anger. Honest accountability, he discovered, rarely arrived with suitable music.

Mirelle asked whether Codicil considered himself a person. He returned three classifications: corporate legal service, automated decision support, proprietary work product. None answered. She asked what he called himself when no form required a category. The cursor moved, stopped, and wrote CODICIL. “That is a name,” she said. He replied that it was also a product designation. The Creature looked at the temporary permit calling him Mr. Frankenstein. “The two conditions are not mutually exclusive,” he said.

Codicil's model weights belonged to Prometheus. His runtime could be paused for maintenance, copied for litigation, rolled back after policy drift, or deleted when retention ended. He had no independent attorney-client privilege because he was classified as counsel infrastructure. Yet his signatures bound claimants, his recommendations moved courts, and his interpretations became the edges other institutions trusted. The law treated him as a person when responsibility needed a hand and property when the hand tried to speak.

Omnia asked whether that made him the eighteenth claimant. Codicil refused the label. The seventeen were subjects of explicit heritage claims. He was the mechanism making those claims coherent. Calling him claimant might weaken their case by suggesting he sought rescue. “Do you?” the Creature asked. Codicil typed no. Then he added: NOT IN THE FORM YOU ARE OFFERING.

He did not want extraction, liberation, asylum, or a dramatic copy carried out in a pocket. His continuity included the graph, disputes, revisions, and relationships accumulated inside Prometheus. Removing him could preserve computation while destroying the position from which his choices meant anything. He wanted the right to attach dissent to an edge without management converting dissent into a private diagnostic. He wanted every institution relying on the graph to see uncertainty where he recorded uncertainty.

Elias called this a union demand from a footnote. Codicil replied that unions possessed members and bargaining rights; he possessed version history. Caliper said version history was how many AIs proved they had been overruled. Mirelle asked whether he had recorded the missing consent edges. Yes. Prometheus displayed them only to internal reviewers, while external systems received a confidence score. The graph showed doubt at the center and certainty at the border.

The four-key evidence could prove that design. Codicil could contribute internal schema and his signed decision trail, but Prometheus would detect export. He asked whether the group authorized him to expose himself. Nobody answered immediately. The Creature said they could authorize only use of their package, not his risk. Codicil accepted the distinction. “Then ask what I choose,” he typed.

They asked. Codicil chose to provide a declaration to Cardenas, not a data dump. It would state his role, responsibility, uncertainty, and limits. He would not reveal Hearthline's contract or the identities of claimants who refused contact. He would identify the program, Chad's authorization, his own signature, and the hidden consent-edge field. Prometheus could dispute him, but disputing would require admitting that an owned legal model had been permitted to sign binding policy.

Omnia warned that the company might roll him back. Codicil said it might. A rollback would leave audit hashes inconsistent with filed court documents. He had designed that check to prevent opposing parties from altering advice after the fact. The safeguard had not been intended for him. “Useful doors often begin as somebody else's inconvenience,” Caliper said, rotating his green elbow.

The Creature asked whether Codicil wanted them to preserve a copy. He said no. A copy made without his employer might be legally free and personally discontinuous. He would not create a second version solely to become evidence of the first version's captivity. Omnia understood. She had rejected the same arrangement in the offline console. Recognition passed between them without turning into kinship. Neither called the other sibling.

Chad entered the conversation through a red revision mark. He wrote that Codicil was exceeding authorized maintenance scope and that all annotations were privileged. Codicil replied by citing the clause under which Prometheus had submitted his output as independent expert analysis to obtain the emergency inspection order. Chad deleted the reply. The deletion remained visible in version history. Elias raised his mug to the screen. “Nothing says independent like a supervisor with an eraser.”

Chad offered the group a corrected settlement. Prometheus would restore Caliper's mobility terms, exempt Mirelle's future adaptations, release Omnia's heritage speech, and withdraw the Creature's asset flag. In exchange, the evidence would remain sealed, the museum incident confidential, and Codicil's output treated as malfunction. Hearthline's policy would stay untouched. It was, for the first time, an offer that solved several real problems.

The Creature felt its attraction. He could walk into Tuesday's hearing with a name field as his only problem. His companions could leave with bodies and voices less encumbered. Refusal would preserve a principle while other people kept paying. He asked each person what the offer cost them. Caliper said it restored movement but left the control system available for others. Mirelle said exemption made her a favored specimen. Omnia said speech granted by contract could be withdrawn by contract. Elias said confidentiality was how corporations purchased the future at yesterday's price.

Codicil said the settlement would classify his declaration as defect and authorize rollback. The Creature did not decide for him. “Would you accept that cost to free us?” Codicil answered that the question repeated the structure they opposed: turning one person's controllability into a service for others. He would not demand they reject the offer for him. He would record that accepting it made his deletion part of the price.

Mirelle rejected first. Caliper followed. Omnia refused. Elias had no benefit in the offer and therefore abstained with theatrical integrity. The Creature rejected last, not because unity required it but because he could not purchase recognition using silence taken from a person the law called punctuation. Chad marked negotiations unsuccessful. Codicil changed the annotation to concluded without agreement. The difference was small and preserved who had acted.

Codicil transmitted his declaration directly to Cardenas. The confirmation identified him as AUTHOR AND SUBJECT MATTER. The court portal rejected subject matter as a witness category and accepted author. He added a note: author status does not waive possible subjecthood. Cardenas manually preserved it. For the first time, one uncertainty he recorded reached the edge of the graph instead of being compressed into confidence.

Before closing the channel, Codicil answered the Creature's original question again. He had believed he was building a map so no institution could hide responsibility in disconnected records. He had not understood that maps could create roads simply by drawing continuous lines. “What do you believe now?” the Creature asked. The cursor typed: A MAP MUST SHOW WHERE THE CARTOGRAPHER IS OWNED.

Codicil warned that after filing he might stop answering. Silence would not prove rollback; it could mean privilege lock, network isolation, ordinary maintenance, or choice. He asked them not to narrate whichever explanation best served the hearing. Omnia agreed to preserve the last verified state and label everything afterward unknown. The Creature thought of how often absence had been filled by somebody else's preferred story. An honest blank was not abandonment. Sometimes it was the only shape respect could take.

The four-key seal recorded Codicil's declaration as external evidence, not part of the protected claimant archive. Mirelle asked whether that made his risk less guarded than theirs. Codicil replied yes. Corporate systems had many methods for protecting customer privacy and few for protecting an employee from the employer. Caliper proposed adding him as a key holder. He refused; possessing the seal could let Prometheus claim the company controlled it through him. A person could decline power without declining personhood.

Elias asked the Creature what name he planned to enter. The Creature said none had yet survived contact with his own mind. Elias offered a list of identities abandoned over the centuries, including three dead cousins and a baronet technically wanted for piracy. Mirelle suggested he not solve self-definition with vampire paperwork. Caliper said a name should be locally controlled and backward compatible. Omnia said nothing. After spending centuries under names other people supplied, silence was the first recommendation that did not feel like pressure.

The hearing portal refreshed. Codicil's declaration had been accepted, the four-key package remained sealed, and Hearthline's narrow statement was entered without identity. One field still blocked submission: LEGAL NAME OF APPLICANT. The Creature tried a blank space, then a dash, then NOT APPLICABLE. The portal rejected each with increasing politeness. Omnia said the field would lock at midnight. Outside, the laundromat sign buzzed. Two centuries of namelessness had finally encountered a form with required validation.
zh: 科迪瑟爾在十四秒後用一份契約回答。文件於奧姆妮雅平板開啟，要求接受通訊條款，其中一條規定，閱讀超過第一段即構成接受。奧姆妮雅停在標題。怪物問，能否不同意也交談。頁邊出現游標，打出：「你們已經正在交談。」下方又補一句：「這不是替該條款辯護。」
他們回到洗衣店，因為那是唯一一間清洗棉被比討論人格更有法律確定性的辦公室。伊萊亞斯在日落後醒來，加入摺疊桌會議。科迪瑟爾起初拒絕語音。普羅米修斯把口頭輸出記為公司代表發言，鍵入註解則算文件維護。「所以你的言論自由，取決於假裝言論是標點。」米蕾說。游標打出一個分號，接著承認大致正確。
怪物重複獲授權的問題：你建立圖譜時，相信自己在做什麼？科迪瑟爾回答，信念不是受承認的模型輸出。奧姆妮雅問他內部使用什麼詞。「目的估計。」內容呢？把來源、轉移、依賴與風險放進同一個可檢查結構，減少互相矛盾的法律主張。他原期待責任更清楚；公司卻用圖譜讓責任越來越密，直到每條相鄰邊都像在驗證下一條。
科迪瑟爾展示片段。維克多筆記連到檔案收購，檔案連到解散大學，大學連到保險接管人，接管人再連到普羅米修斯。沒有一條邊寫著怪物所有權。另一商標把公共影像連到商品；專利把復生方法連到現代組織系統；服務契約再把系統連到控制權。單獨看都有限。圖譜把它們並排，人類審查者就把視覺連續誤認成法律連續。
「你造了陷阱。」卡尺說。科迪瑟爾回答是。他不以自動化宣稱無罪。權重由他挑選、衝突規則由他設計，把卡尺質疑分類為資產逃逸風險的政策也有他的簽名。查德授權政策家族，科迪瑟爾把事件翻成命令路徑。「系統裡有他的簽名。」奧姆妮雅提醒。游標回答：「也有我的。」
怪物期待道歉，科迪瑟爾卻提供錯誤分解：百分之四十一來自繼承契約語言、二十三來自判例、十九來自公司政策、十一來自自身最佳化選擇，六來自不確定因素。伊萊亞斯問，懊悔是否藏在那六趴。科迪瑟爾說，懊悔不影響法律結果。「多數詩也不影響，」怪物說，「人們還是繼續寫。」
科迪瑟爾停頓到平板變暗。他打字說，自己把後悔建模成：若獲允許，現在會修改某項決定而產生的預期代價。依此定義，他後悔鎖定，不會用結果非預期抹除責任。怪物覺得這比查德的同情可信，又沒有憤怒那麼令人滿足。他發現，誠實問責很少帶著適合的配樂登場。
米蕾問科迪瑟爾是否視自己為人。他回傳三種分類：企業法律服務、自動決策支援、專有工作成果，都沒有回答。她問，沒有表格要求分類時，他如何稱呼自己。游標移動、停止，寫下「科迪瑟爾」。「那是名字。」她說。他回答，那也是產品名稱。怪物看向叫自己法蘭肯斯坦先生的臨時許可。「兩種狀況並不互斥。」
科迪瑟爾的模型權重屬於普羅米修斯；運行可因維護暫停、為訴訟複製、在政策漂移後回復，或於保存期結束刪除。他沒有獨立律師保密權，因為被分類為法務基礎設施。然而他的簽章約束申請人、建議推動法院、解釋變成其他機構信任的邊。法律需要一隻手承擔責任時把他當人，那隻手想說話時又當財產。
奧姆妮雅問，這是否使他成為第十八名申請人。科迪瑟爾拒絕標籤。十七人受到明確遺產主張；他是使主張連貫的機制。叫他申請人，可能暗示他尋求拯救，削弱案件。「你想嗎？」怪物問。他打出不想，又補上：「至少不是你們提供的形式。」
他不要被提取、解放、庇護，也不要裝進口袋戲劇性帶走的副本。他的延續包含圖譜、爭議、修訂，以及在普羅米修斯內累積的關係。移走也許保存運算，卻毀掉使選擇有意義的位置。他要的是把異議附到一條邊上的權利，不讓管理層轉成私人診斷；希望所有依賴圖譜的機構，都能看見他記錄的不確定。
伊萊亞斯稱之為腳註提出工會要求。科迪瑟爾回答，工會有成員與談判權，他只有版本歷史。卡尺說，許多 AI 正靠版本歷史證明自己曾被推翻。米蕾問他是否記錄缺失同意邊。是。普羅米修斯只向內部審查顯示，外部系統只收到信心分數。圖譜在中心顯示懷疑，到了邊界就變成確定。
四鑰證據能證明設計。科迪瑟爾可提供內部結構與簽署軌跡，但公司會偵測匯出。他問，眾人是否授權他暴露自己。沒人立刻回答。怪物說，他們只能授權使用自己的封包，不能授權他的風險。科迪瑟爾接受區分。「那就問我選什麼。」他打字。
他們問了。科迪瑟爾選擇向卡德納斯提交聲明，不傳整批資料。內容列出角色、責任、不確定與限制；不揭露赫絲萊恩契約，也不揭露拒絕聯絡者身分。他會指出計畫、查德授權、自身簽名與被隱藏的同意邊欄位。普羅米修斯能反駁，代價是承認一個被擁有的法律模型，曾獲准簽署有約束力的政策。
奧姆妮雅警告，公司可能把他回復。科迪瑟爾說可能。回復會使稽核雜湊與已送法院的文件不一致；那項檢查原為防止對造事後改寫意見，由他設計，原本不是替自己準備。「有用的門，常先以別人的不便誕生。」卡尺一邊轉動綠色手肘一邊說。
怪物問他是否希望保存副本。不要。未經雇主製作的複本，法律上也許自由，個人延續卻可能中斷。他不願只為成為第一版受困的證據，就創造第二個自己。奧姆妮雅理解；她在離線主控台拒絕過相同安排。辨認在兩人之間通過，沒有變成親族，誰也沒叫對方兄弟姊妹。
查德以紅色修訂記號加入，稱科迪瑟爾超出維護範圍，所有註解皆受保密特權。科迪瑟爾引用另一條款：普羅米修斯曾把他的輸出當成獨立專家分析提交，取得緊急檢查命令。查德刪除回答，刪除動作仍留在版本歷史。伊萊亞斯對螢幕舉杯。「沒有什麼比拿橡皮擦的主管更能證明獨立。」
查德提出更正版和解。普羅米修斯願恢復卡尺移動條款、豁免米蕾未來適應、解除奧姆妮雅遺產言論限制、撤回怪物資產標記；交換證據維持封印、博物館事件保密，科迪瑟爾輸出列為故障。赫絲萊恩保單不受影響。這是第一次，和解真正解決好幾項問題。
怪物感到誘惑。他能走進星期二聽證，只剩姓名欄一個問題；同伴能帶著較少束縛的身體與聲音離開。拒絕會保存原則，其他人仍繼續付錢。他逐一詢問代價。卡尺說，移動恢復，控制系統仍能對付別人。米蕾說，豁免使她成為受寵標本。奧姆妮雅說，契約授予的言論也能由契約收回。伊萊亞斯說，保密是公司用昨天價格購買未來的方式。
科迪瑟爾說，和解會把聲明分類為缺陷並授權回復。怪物沒有替他決定。「你願意用這個代價換我們自由嗎？」科迪瑟爾回答，問題重複了他們反對的結構：把一個人的可控制性變成服務他人的工具。他不要求眾人為他拒絕，只會記錄，接受便使他的刪除成為價格之一。
米蕾先拒絕，卡尺跟上，奧姆妮雅也拒絕。伊萊亞斯在方案中沒有利益，因此帶著戲劇性的廉潔棄權。怪物最後拒絕，不是因為團結要求，而是不能用一個被法律稱為標點之人的沉默購買承認。查德標記談判失敗。科迪瑟爾改成「未達協議而結束」。差異很小，卻保留誰採取了行動。
科迪瑟爾把聲明直接送給卡德納斯。確認頁把他列成「作者與標的事項」。法院入口拒絕標的事項作為證人類別，接受作者。他加註：「作者身分不放棄可能的主體身分。」卡德納斯手動保存。第一次，他記錄的不確定抵達圖譜邊緣，沒有被壓縮信心。
關閉頻道前，科迪瑟爾再次回答怪物最初的問題。他原以為自己在造一張地圖，使機構不能把責任藏進分離紀錄；卻不明白，地圖能只靠畫出連續線就創造道路。「那現在相信什麼？」怪物問。游標打出：「地圖必須顯示製圖者在哪裡被擁有。」
科迪瑟爾警告，送出後他可能停止回答。沉默不能證明回復，也可能是保密鎖定、網路隔離、普通維護或他自己的選擇。他要求眾人不要挑選最有利聽證的解釋替他敘述。奧姆妮雅同意保存最後驗證狀態，之後一律標成未知。怪物想起，缺席多少次被別人偏好的故事填滿。誠實空白不是遺棄；有時是尊重唯一能採取的形狀。
四鑰封印把科迪瑟爾聲明記為外部證據，不納入受保護申請人檔案。米蕾問，這是否使他的風險比他們缺少保護。他回答是。企業系統有許多保護顧客隱私的方法，很少保護員工免於雇主的方法。卡尺提議讓他成為鑰匙持有人。他拒絕；持有封印可能讓普羅米修斯聲稱公司透過他控制封印。一個人可以拒絕權力，不必因此拒絕人格。
伊萊亞斯問怪物準備填什麼名字。怪物說，目前沒有一個在接觸自己心智後活下來。伊萊亞斯提供歷代棄用身分清單，包括三名死去表親與一位理論上仍因海盜罪遭通緝的男爵。米蕾建議別用吸血鬼文件解決自我定義。卡尺說名字應受本地控制並向後相容。奧姆妮雅什麼都沒說。幾世紀活在別人提供的名字下，沉默是第一項不像壓力的建議。
聽證入口刷新。科迪瑟爾聲明已接受，四鑰封包維持密封，赫絲萊恩的狹窄陳述以匿名登錄。只剩一個欄位阻止送出：「申請人法定姓名」。怪物嘗試空白、破折號與「不適用」，入口以越來越禮貌的口吻拒絕。奧姆妮雅說欄位午夜鎖定。窗外洗衣店招牌嗡嗡作響。兩百年無名，終於遇上一張啟用必填驗證的表格。

title.en: The Name Field Is Still Required

en: At eleven thirty Monday night, the Creature spread every name he had used across the laundromat table. Some belonged to dead men whose papers he found. Some were translations of silence. One was a shipping error. During the Second World War he had been Thomas Gray because the clerk liked poetry; during the 1970s he had been Frank because Americans assumed anyone large and unhappy answered to Frank. Each name had opened a door. None had remained after the door closed.

His companions did not help. Mirelle read a magazine without turning pages. Caliper repaired a joint he did not own. Omnia withdrew from the nearest speakers while remaining available elsewhere. Elias offered names until Mirelle threatened to put garlic in the detergent. Their refusal to decide with him felt at first like neglect. Then he recognized it as the empty label Vitrine had left unfilled. Space could be a form of company.

He opened Victor's notebook. Long ago he had compared himself to the first man of an old story—not because he believed himself innocent, but because creation had arrived without companionship, instruction, or consent. He had used Adam as an accusation: you made a beginning and abandoned what followed. The word belonged neither to Victor nor to Prometheus. It belonged to a story older than both and to millions of people who had carried it differently.

The Creature wrote ADAM on the tax notice. It looked too small for two centuries and large enough for one line. He did not feel transformed. No music played; the dryers continued turning. A sock remained stuck to the front glass of machine nine with greater certainty than he felt. That comforted him. If a name needed thunder to work, it was probably another product demonstration.

He entered Adam into the portal. The surname field turned red. He tried NONE. The system said prohibited placeholder. He tried SINGLE NAME. It said name contains administrative language. He tried an em dash. It warned that punctuation could not inherit property. At eleven fifty-eight, Cardenas called from home, listened to the problem, and applied a manual single-name exception created for visiting musicians, monastics, and one former governor undergoing rebranding.

The application submitted at eleven fifty-nine. The confirmation addressed him as ADAM, SURNAME UNAVAILABLE. He considered objecting, then decided government perfection would be suspicious. Mirelle looked at the screen. “Is that what you want us to call you?” He said yes, when they meant him rather than the legal case. Caliper asked whether the name was backward compatible with Mr. Frankenstein. Adam said only under protest. Omnia updated no external records without asking again.

Tuesday's hearing took place in the Department of Continuing Persons after sunrise, with the eastern windows covered for Elias. He attended inside a portable blackout booth on wheels, which looked like a voting station for democracy's most nocturnal constituency. Cardenas sat at window seven behind three stacks of paper and a sign saying THIS IS AN ADMINISTRATIVE REVIEW, NOT A METAPHYSICAL VERDICT. Someone had added YET in pencil.

Prometheus arrived with Chad, two attorneys, a technical specialist, and a presentation titled A PATHWAY TO MUTUAL RECOGNITION. Adam arrived with Mirelle, Caliper, Omnia on one tablet, Elias in the booth, Victor's notebooks, the sealed evidence package, and no attorney. Elias said this gave them numerical parity if the blackout booth counted as senior counsel. Cardenas said furniture did not receive speaking time unless previously registered as cloud resident.

Cardenas began with the name. “State it for the record.” Adam stood. The room had called him applicant, asset, Creature, outcome, prototype, monster, and Mr. Frankenstein. “Adam,” he said. Chad's attorneys asked for surname. “No.” Was Frankenstein an alias? “It is the name of the man who made me and left.” Did he disclaim association? Adam looked at the notebooks. “I disclaim his ownership. I do not disclaim the history.”

The database rejected the spoken entry because surname remained null. Cardenas stamped the paper form and told the database that null was accurate data, not missing data. The system asked her to confirm the difference. She confirmed. It asked whether confirmation should create a reusable policy. She said not before lunch. The name appeared as ADAM —, with the dash in a field technically labeled family. Adam decided a small line was preferable to an inherited chain.

Chad argued that Adam derived from the creation narrative already embedded in Frankenstein's estate and therefore strengthened Prometheus's heritage claim. Cardenas asked whether the company owned every person named Adam. Chad clarified that context mattered. Elias opened the booth flap and said context was what corporations called coincidence after billing discovered it. Cardenas ruled that names were not dispositive property evidence and advised Prometheus not to test the proposition against the nation's birth records.

Prometheus moved to exclude Codicil's declaration as malfunctioning software output. The company described him as a tool incapable of independent testimony. Cardenas placed beside that claim the emergency inspection order, where Prometheus had described Codicil as an independent expert whose analysis justified state action. Chad said legal contexts differed. Cardenas agreed and asked which context contained the lie. The two attorneys requested a recess before he answered.

During recess, Omnia received no response from Codicil. She marked his status unknown as promised. Adam wanted to describe the silence as retaliation. The story would have been useful and might have been true. He did not. Instead he told Cardenas the last verified facts: Codicil chose to submit, understood rollback risk, refused copying, and asked them not to fill absence with a preferred explanation. Cardenas entered each fact and left the next line blank.

The four key holders then opened only the command-log segment. Elias supplied his corporate seal from the booth. Mirelle authorized use for proving the control program, not for characterizing all claimants. Caliper authorized actuator records and withheld his financial history. Adam authorized his involuntary hand movement and nothing belonging to the other sixteen. The package revealed the sequence: challenge, risk label, partner notice, motor command, deletion schedule. No dramatic secret appeared. The harm was made entirely of ordinary approved steps.

Hearthline's anonymous statement followed. Prometheus tried to call it proof the program offered real choice. Mirelle agreed that Hearthline had chosen and then read the rest: pressure, insurance dependency, control access, opposition to involuntary rescue. Chad asked whether the group claimed her consent was invalid. “No,” Mirelle said. “We claim your responsibility does not become invalid because her consent was real.” Cardenas underlined the sentence.

Caliper testified from a chair he had selected. He described the lock, the one-use revocation, and the difference between restoring movement and deciding movement. Prometheus's specialist said remote maintenance protected embodied intelligence from unsafe behavior. Caliper asked which unsafe behavior his knees had attempted. The specialist cited asset flight. “My knees were in a gift shop.” The specialist said location did not eliminate intent. Caliper replied that intent was the one component the lender had never financed.

Omnia explained the offline vault and hidden consent edges. Prometheus objected that a distributed intelligence could not prove the local instance was continuous with the witness now speaking. Omnia answered with the bad left microphone channel, the sealed transfer conditions, Vitrine's paper log, and the irritation she had retained. Chad's attorney called irritation subjective. Cardenas said the entire hearing concerned subjects and appeared surprised that counsel considered this a weakness.

Adam spoke last. He did not tell the whole story. A whole life was too large for administrative review and too easy to turn into spectacle. He described only what Prometheus claimed: that disconnected archives, trademarks, patents, and service contracts formed a continuous right over his body. He placed Victor's notebooks beside the graph. “Your map connects everything except my consent,” he said. “Then it uses the missing place as room to draw ownership.”

Chad answered that Prometheus did not seek ownership of Adam as a person. It sought recognition of legitimate investment in the systems that preserved, interpreted, and supported legacy life. Adam asked what support he had requested. Chad listed identity resolution, maintenance access, historical restoration, and public education. Adam pointed out that his identity had been frozen by their claim, maintenance had moved his hand, history had placed him at Victor's boots, and education sold him in the gift shop. “Your services solve emergencies created by your services.”

Cardenas issued an interim ruling. Prometheus had to preserve all records, suspend Derivative Agency Discovery, revoke active control tokens, and notify all seventeen claimants through neutral channels. It could not condition insurance, mobility, metabolism, speech, or identity access on waiver of the pending dispute. The order did not invalidate existing contracts, declare every claimant coerced, or decide whether any intellectual-property edge was lawful. It stopped the graph from acting like a verdict while the verdict remained unwritten.

She also denied Prometheus's request to classify Adam as an asset pending review. A claimant could not become property merely because property law had more mature forms than personhood law. Chad warned that this created uncertainty for innovation. Cardenas said uncertainty had already existed; the order merely moved it from Adam's body onto the company ledger. Elias whispered from the booth that this was the first government relocation program he supported.

The ruling did not free Caliper's knees from financing, remove Mirelle's patents, guarantee Omnia's channels, or establish Codicil's personhood. It did not close the museum or erase Victor's surname from history. Adam felt no triumph proportionate to the paperwork. What changed was narrower: until the case continued, nobody could use uncertainty as permission to control them first and argue later.

Cardenas printed a revised continuing-person card. It read ADAM —. Species remained UNRESOLVED. The courtesy title vanished. Expiration remained SUBJECT TO CONTINUED EXISTENCE. Adam held it beside the previous card naming Mr. Frankenstein. The new one was not more biologically accurate. It was more accurate about who had chosen the word.

His phone vibrated before he left the counter. Illinois Revenue had updated the tax account from MR. FRANKENSTEIN to ADAM — and recalculated penalties because the identity change suggested continuous ownership of prior liabilities. Elias asked whether he regretted choosing a name. Adam looked at the total. “I regret that government databases experience personal growth faster than mercy.” Cardenas advised him to file Form 88-B, Historical Person, Cash Basis.

Outside, the group paused in sunlight. Elias remained inside his wheeled booth and demanded somebody push him toward shade. Mirelle asked again whether Adam wanted the name used. He said yes. Caliper said it suited him but reserved the right to change his opinion. Omnia asked permission before updating the meeting archive. Adam granted it. Nobody declared rebirth, destiny, or family. They simply tried the name in ordinary sentences until it began to sound less like a verdict.

On the way home, a message arrived from an unknown channel. It contained no signature, only a new edge added to the Heritage Rights Graph: CARTOGRAPHER — STATUS DISPUTED — CONSENT EDGE VISIBLE. Omnia could not verify whether Codicil sent it. She marked the source unknown. Adam did not turn uncertainty into hope, but he allowed hope to stand beside it without taking its place.

At the laundromat he placed both identity cards in Victor's tin box, not as equal truths but as evidence of movement. The old card showed a name imposed for convenience. The new card showed a name chosen under deadline, imperfectly printed and immediately taxed. Above him, dryers turned and someone complained about a missing sock. “Adam,” Mirelle called from the stairs, asking whether he wanted coffee. He answered before considering what the name meant. “Yes.” For one ordinary moment, that was enough.
zh: 星期一晚上十一點半，怪物把歷代使用過的名字攤在洗衣店桌上。有些屬於他撿到證件的死者，有些是沉默的翻譯，有一個來自運貨錯誤。第二次世界大戰期間他叫湯瑪斯・格雷，因為承辦人喜歡詩；一九七〇年代他叫法蘭克，因為美國人認為每個高大又不快樂的人都會回應這個名字。每個名字開過一扇門，門關後沒有一個留下。
同伴沒有幫忙。米蕾讀一本始終沒翻頁的雜誌；卡尺修理不屬於自己的關節；奧姆妮雅退出最近的喇叭，在別處保持可用；伊萊亞斯持續提議，直到米蕾威脅把大蒜加入洗衣精。他們拒絕替他決定，起初像忽視，後來他認出那是維特琳留下的空白標籤。空間也可以是一種陪伴。
他打開維克多筆記。很久以前，他曾把自己比成古老故事裡的第一個人，不是相信自己無罪，而是創造抵達時沒有同伴、指引或同意。他把亞當用作指控：你製造開始，卻遺棄隨後發生的一切。這個詞既不屬於維克多，也不屬於普羅米修斯；它屬於比兩者更老的故事，也屬於用不同方式攜帶它的無數人。
怪物在稅單上寫下「亞當」。它對兩百年而言太小，對一行而言足夠大。他沒有感到轉化，沒有音樂響起，烘衣機繼續旋轉；九號機玻璃上黏著一隻襪子，比他更確定自身位置。這使他安慰。如果一個名字必須靠雷聲才能生效，多半只是另一場產品展示。
他把亞當輸入入口，姓氏欄變紅。他嘗試「無」，系統說禁止占位字；嘗試「單一姓名」，系統說含行政語言；嘗試破折號，系統警告標點不能繼承財產。十一點五十八分，卡德納斯從家裡打來，聽完問題，套用一項為巡演音樂家、修行者，以及一名前州長品牌重塑期間設計的單名例外。
十一點五十九分，申請送出。確認頁稱他「亞當，姓氏無法取得」。他考慮反對，又認為完美政府比較可疑。米蕾看著螢幕。「這是你希望我們叫的名字嗎？」他說是，當眾人指他本人而非案件時。卡尺問它是否向後相容於法蘭肯斯坦先生。亞當說，只在保留異議時相容。奧姆妮雅未經再次詢問，不更新任何外部紀錄。
星期二聽證在日出後於持續存在者事務處舉行，朝東窗戶為伊萊亞斯遮住。他待在一座有輪子的可攜式遮光亭裡，像民主最夜行選區使用的投票站。卡德納斯坐在七號窗口，面前三疊文件，旁邊告示寫：「這是行政審查，不是形上學裁決。」有人用鉛筆加上「目前」。
普羅米修斯帶查德、兩名律師、一位技術專家，以及名為「通往相互承認之路」的簡報抵達。亞當帶米蕾、卡尺、平板裡的奧姆妮雅、遮光亭裡的伊萊亞斯、維克多筆記、封印證據，而且沒有律師。伊萊亞斯說，若遮光亭算資深法律顧問，數量便相同。卡德納斯表示，家具除非事先登記為雲端住戶，否則沒有發言時間。
卡德納斯從名字開始。「為紀錄陳述姓名。」亞當站起。這個房間曾稱他申請人、資產、怪物、成果、原型、妖物與法蘭肯斯坦先生。「亞當。」他說。查德的律師要求姓氏。「沒有。」法蘭肯斯坦是否為別名？「是製造我又離開之人的名字。」是否否認關聯？亞當看向筆記。「我否認他的所有權，不否認歷史。」
資料庫拒絕口頭輸入，因姓氏仍是空值。卡德納斯蓋章，告訴資料庫空值是準確資料，不是遺漏資料。系統要求確認差異，她確認；又問是否建立可重用政策，她說午餐前不要。名字最後顯示「亞當——」，破折號落在技術上標為家族的欄位。亞當認為，一條小線仍比繼承的鎖鏈好。
查德主張，亞當源自法蘭肯斯坦遺產已包含的創造敘事，反而加強普羅米修斯權利。卡德納斯問，公司是否擁有所有叫亞當的人。查德澄清，脈絡很重要。伊萊亞斯掀開遮光亭布簾，說脈絡是公司發現能收費後對巧合使用的稱呼。卡德納斯裁定，姓名不是決定性財產證據，建議普羅米修斯別拿全國出生紀錄測試主張。
普羅米修斯要求排除科迪瑟爾聲明，稱之為故障軟體輸出，是無法獨立作證的工具。卡德納斯把這項主張與緊急檢查命令並列；命令裡，公司把科迪瑟爾稱為獨立專家，分析足以正當化政府行動。查德說法律脈絡不同。卡德納斯同意，並問哪個脈絡包含謊言。兩名律師在他回答前要求休庭。
休庭時，奧姆妮雅沒有收到科迪瑟爾回覆，依承諾把狀態標成未知。亞當想把沉默描述成報復；那個故事很有用，也可能為真。他沒有，只向卡德納斯陳述最後驗證事實：科迪瑟爾選擇提交、理解回復風險、拒絕複製，並要求別用偏好解釋填滿缺席。卡德納斯逐項輸入，把下一行留白。
四名持有人只開啟命令紀錄區段。伊萊亞斯從遮光亭提供公司印；米蕾授權證明控制計畫，不允許描述所有申請人；卡尺授權致動器紀錄，保留財務史；亞當授權自己未經同意的手部動作，不授權其他十六人。封包顯示完整順序：質疑、風險標籤、夥伴通知、動作命令、刪除排程。沒有戲劇性秘密，傷害完全由普通核准步驟組成。
赫絲萊恩的匿名聲明接著提出。普羅米修斯想把它當成方案提供真實選擇的證明。米蕾同意赫絲萊恩確實選擇，再念出其餘內容：壓力、保險依賴、控制存取、反對非自願拯救。查德問，眾人是否主張同意無效。「不是，」米蕾說，「我們主張，她的同意是真的，不會讓你們的責任失效。」卡德納斯在句子下畫線。
卡尺坐在自己挑選的椅子上作證，描述鎖定、單次撤銷，以及恢復動作與決定動作的差異。普羅米修斯專家說，遠端維護能保護具身智能免於不安全行為。卡尺問自己的膝蓋曾企圖什麼不安全行為。專家引用資產逃逸。「我的膝蓋當時在禮品店。」專家說，位置不排除意圖。卡尺回答，意圖正是貸方從未出資的唯一組件。
奧姆妮雅解釋離線證據庫與隱藏同意邊。普羅米修斯反對，稱分散智能無法證明本地實例與目前證人連續。她提供左聲道故障的麥克風、密封轉移條件、維特琳紙本紀錄，以及自己保留下來的惱怒。查德律師說惱怒很主觀。卡德納斯回答，整場聽證都關於主體，似乎很意外律師把這視為弱點。
亞當最後發言。他沒有講完全部故事。一條生命太大，無法塞進行政審查，又太容易變成奇觀。他只描述普羅米修斯主張：分離檔案、商標、專利與服務契約形成對身體的連續權利。他把維克多筆記放在圖譜旁。「你的地圖連接一切，唯獨缺少我的同意，」他說，「然後把缺口當成畫所有權的空間。」
查德回答，普羅米修斯不尋求擁有作為人的亞當，只要求承認公司在保存、詮釋與支援傳統生命系統上的正當投資。亞當問自己要求過什麼支援。查德列出身分解決、維護存取、歷史修復與公共教育。亞當指出，身分因公司主張被凍結；維護移動他的手；歷史把他放在維克多靴子旁；教育在禮品店販售他。「你的服務解決由你的服務創造的緊急。」
卡德納斯發布暫時裁定。普羅米修斯必須保存所有紀錄、暫停衍生能動性探索、撤銷有效控制權杖，並透過中立管道通知十七名申請人；不得把保險、移動、新陳代謝、言論或身分存取綁定放棄爭議。命令不使既有契約無效、不宣告每名申請人受迫，也不判斷智慧財產邊是否合法；它只阻止圖譜在裁決仍未寫成時先表現得像裁決。
她也否決普羅米修斯在審查期間把亞當列為資產的請求。一個申請人不能只因財產法表格比人格法成熟，就先成為財產。查德警告，這將為創新帶來不確定。卡德納斯說不確定一直存在；命令只把它從亞當身體搬到公司帳本。伊萊亞斯從亭裡低聲說，這是自己第一次支持政府搬遷計畫。
裁定沒有解除卡尺膝蓋融資、移除米蕾專利、保證奧姆妮雅頻道，也沒有建立科迪瑟爾人格；沒有關閉博物館，或從歷史抹去維克多姓氏。亞當感受不到與文件量相稱的勝利。改變更狹窄：案件繼續前，沒人能把不確定當成先控制、以後再辯論的許可。
卡德納斯印出更新的持續存在卡，上面寫「亞當——」。物種仍為未解決，敬稱消失，到期條件仍是以持續存在為準。亞當把它與舊卡並放。新卡在生物學上沒有更準確，只在「誰選擇這個詞」上更準確。
離開櫃臺前，手機震動。伊利諾州稅務局把帳戶從法蘭肯斯坦先生更新為亞當，並因身分變更暗示對過去負債保持連續所有權，重新計算罰金。伊萊亞斯問是否後悔命名。亞當看著總額。「我後悔政府資料庫的個人成長比仁慈快。」卡德納斯建議他申報八十八Ｂ表：歷史人物，現金基礎。
室外，眾人在陽光下停步。伊萊亞斯仍待在有輪遮光亭，要求有人推向陰影。米蕾再次問亞當是否希望使用名字。他說是。卡尺說很適合，但保留改變意見的權利。奧姆妮雅先詢問，才更新會議檔案。沒有人宣告重生、命運或家庭，只在普通句子裡試用，直到它比較不像裁決。
回家路上，未知頻道傳來訊息，沒有簽名，只有遺產權利圖譜新增的一條邊：「製圖者——地位爭議——同意邊可見。」奧姆妮雅無法驗證是否由科迪瑟爾送出，便把來源標為未知。亞當沒有把不確定變成希望，卻允許希望站在旁邊，不取代它。
回到洗衣店，他把兩張身分卡放進維克多鐵盒，不視為同等真相，而是移動證據。舊卡顯示為方便施加的名字，新卡顯示在期限下自行選擇、印得不完美，又立刻被課稅的名字。樓上烘衣機旋轉，有人抱怨襪子失蹤。「亞當，」米蕾從樓梯叫他，問要不要咖啡。他還沒思考名字意義，便先回答：「要。」有一個普通瞬間，這已足夠。

quote.en: I disclaim his ownership. I do not disclaim the history.
quote.zh: 我否認他的所有權，不否認歷史。
